name: CAP Dev Stack
description: Installs SAP CAP development tools as global npm packages (cds-dk, mbt, mta). Requires Node.js / npm to be installed first.

cds-dk.description: @sap/cds-dk version. 'latest' is resolved at build time and may change between rebuilds; use an exact version for stability, or 'none' to skip.

mbt.description: mbt (MTA Build Tool) version. 'latest' is resolved at build time and may change between rebuilds; use an exact version for stability, or 'none' to skip.

mta.description: mta (Cloud MTA Build Tool) version. 'latest' is resolved at build time and may change between rebuilds; use an exact version for stability, or 'none' to skip.
